title: Acme factory shutdown
text: Acme Components said a fire halted production at its Dallas factory. The company expects the shutdown to last ten calendar days. Boreal Motors purchases components from Acme Components.

title: Alder updates revenue guidance
text: On 2026-10-02, Alder Technologies lowered its full-year 2026 revenue guidance from USD 5.0 billion to USD 4.5 billion. The company attributed the reduction to weaker demand.

title: Understanding stock splits
text: This educational article explains what a stock split is and how share counts work. It does not announce a transaction, earnings release, financing, lawsuit or production disruption by any company.
